reference_sql:
WITH last_orders AS (  -- one row per customer
  SELECT customer_id, DATE '2026-01-05' - MAX(CAST(order_ts AS DATE)) AS days_since
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN days_since <= 30 THEN 'active'
            WHEN days_since <= 90 THEN 'cooling'
            ELSE 'lapsed' END AS recency_band,
       COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM last_orders
GROUP BY 1

WITH last_orders AS (  -- one row per customer
  SELECT customer_id, date_diff('day', MAX(order_ts), DATE '2026-01-05') AS days_since
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN days_since > 90 THEN 'lapsed' WHEN days_since > 30 THEN 'cooling' ELSE 'active' END AS recency_band, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM last_orders
GROUP BY 1

solver.query:
WITH last_order AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MAX(CAST(order_ts AS DATE)) AS last_day
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN DATE '2026-01-05' - last_day <= 30 THEN 'active'
            WHEN DATE '2026-01-05' - last_day <= 90 THEN 'cooling'
            ELSE 'lapsed' END AS recency_band,
       COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM last_order
GROUP BY 1
